About.title: Our Story
About.intro: Every journey has a story. We are here to help you discover incredible places, experience local culture, and make memories that stay with you.
About.storyP1: Travel with Limon is built around a simple idea: travelling should be more than moving from one place to another. It should bring you closer to new landscapes, cultures, food, and people.
About.storyP2: Whether you are dreaming of mountain views, a peaceful getaway, or an exciting holiday with family and friends, we want to make planning your next adventure easier and more personal.
About.valuesDescription: The principles behind the way we plan, guide, and experience every journey.
About.ctaDescription: Tell us what kind of journey you have in mind. Let's start planning an experience you will always remember.

faqs.question: How can I book a trip?
faqs.answer: Send us your destination, travel dates, and the number of travellers. Our team will get in touch to discuss the next steps.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a customised travel plan?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Share the places you would like to visit, your preferred dates, and any special requirements in the message form.

faqs.question: How can I confirm package details and payment options?
faqs.answer: Contact us directly before making a payment. We will share the available package details and explain the payment process with you.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: Travel with Limon is based in Falakata, Alipurduar, West Bengal. Please contact us before visiting so we can coordinate with you.
